subject: Pests
body:
Mareika, just got a heads-up from the other 244 residents about some potential termites. I'm so sorry about that - not something I've ever experienced there.

Just wanted to let you know that we're having someone come to investigate ASAP. If needed, Andreas will likely coordinate with you.

So sorry - thanks for your patience.
_note: This is an OUTBOUND example from Shaw - shows owner-initiated outreach voice anchor (warm, slightly understated, owner-driven communication about a building-wide issue).
